name: grass-spread
comment: BlockGrass (BlockGrass.java:30-49) on a dirt platform: grass stripes (every other row of the north half) and four single grass blocks under the sky spread to random dirt within 3x5x3 whose top is lit; grass under stone (opacity 255, light 0) turns to dirt; grass in a closed stone box (light 0, air above) neither spreads nor dies. Plants (BlockFlower.java, BlockMushroom.java, BlockDeadBush.java, BlockTallGrass.java): a dandelion in the dark box and a dead bush on dirt cannot stay and drop on their first random tick (checkFlowerChange); mushrooms stay in the dark (full light < 13 over an opaque cube); BlockMushroom.updateTick never calls checkFlowerChange, so the two in sunlight stay until a neighbour changes at t=300 (BlockFlower.onNeighborBlockChange, then BlockMushroom.canBlockStay fails), and the one in the box may spread. set_time 14000 at t=600 (night: getBlockLightValue below 9, so no more spreading). block_box of the platform every 50, rng_state every tick.
